Tango Me | Senior Backend / Frontend / Android / QA | Limassol, Cyprus | Hybrid | Relocation

Tango is a live-streaming platform with 400M+ registered users — high-scale B2C at the intersection of video streaming, creator economy, and social features. I'm an Engineering Manager building two product teams focused on activation and retention. Looking for engineers who take ownership and push back when something doesn't make sense. Backend: Java 17–21, Spring Boot, GCP, Apache Kafka, MySQL, Redis, Aerospike Frontend: React 16+ (hooks), TypeScript/ES6+, Redux + Redux Toolkit, SASS, Jest Android: Kotlin/Java, Dagger2, Compose UI, Kotlin Flows, Coroutines Open roles:

Senior Backend Engineer Senior Frontend Engineer Senior Android Engineer QA Engineer (automation-focused)

Relocation to Limassol, Cyprus: full relocation package, work permit + residence permit for spouse, hybrid (1 remote day/week), stock options, competitive salary + performance bonus, medical insurance, meals in office. Careers: https://business.tango.me/careers Direct contact: https://t.me/joetribbb
